steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Rank. Each review item is placed by its evidence and whether a quality issue has an action.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

findings.title: Standard item missing from the form
findings.fix: Add the item to the form

example:
Illustrative example: the items and results are made up, not real output.
Summary: 3 findings (1 high, 1 medium, 1 low).
[high] eng-review-2.md:12  Review item with no evidence.
       Fix: Attach the evidence.
[medium] action-log.csv:19  Standard item missing from the form.
       Fix: Add the item to the form.
[low] form-standard.md:26  Quality issue with no action.
       Fix: Record the action.
Not checked: The client's experience.
pros: Checks an item with no evidence, a standard item missing from the form, and a quality issue with no action.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-hrc-quality-review skill on the records for this review.
